en.html:
[MUMBAImasa Censor Board: original poem detained. Approved substitute follows.]

In this weary world, let my troubled mind find rest.
Send one consoling verse—
not three new worries dressed in five fine lines.

景明「後撰和歌集にございます」
邦氏「――――」
ja.text: 景明「後撰和歌集にございます」邦氏「――――」

en.html:
Kuniuji looked as though the message had arrived without its meaning. I supplied only the collection's name.

Poetry was basic education for Yamato's nobility. This much clue should be sufficient.

A few seconds for the education to take effect.

ja.html:
最初、何のことやらわからなかった様子の邦氏へ、
俺は端的にその一言だけ告げた。
　大和にあって貴族に列する者ならば、歌は基礎教養
の範疇。これで充分だろう。

　数秒して。

I search for words in vain.
If silence counts as poetry,
accept this finished masterpiece:

[The poet has fainted.]
